verses.1: Let them try, and there will be no evil one to persecute them. The righteous will be safe from harm.
verses.2: In the land of many people, their laws and regulations are known. And through human understanding, one can understand them.
verses.3: It’s bitter and painful; those who are poor suffer greatly. There’s no hope for them.
verses.4: Those who abandon the Torah will be glorified by the wicked. And those who keep the Torah will be punished.
verses.5: The wicked will not understand judgment; but those who seek the Lord will understand everything.
verses.6: Tov-Rash walks along his path, overcoming all obstacles. And he becomes rich.
verses.7: They create a law from nothing; they are like those who spread lies and deceit. They are the children of their fathers.
verses.8: May they be filled with joy and love, and may they be able to help those who are in need.
verses.9: He was deprived of the ability to hear the Torah; his prayers also became ineffective.
verses.10: The righteous will be punished along the wrong path; in their wickedness, they will fall. But the good will be rewarded.
verses.11: A man who seems wise in his eyes is actually rich; but the poor understand what’s really important.
verses.12: In the righteous, there is great honor and glory; but when the wicked rise up, people will seek them out.
verses.13: His sins will not be forgiven; he will be punished and abandoned.
verses.14: For those who are always afraid, and whose hearts are filled with sorrow, they will surely fall into evil.
verses.15: Arion and Dov Shokk are the rulers of the wicked over the poor people.
verses.16: I say that there’s no wisdom or understanding in him; he loves to do things that will take many years to complete.
verses.17: Man was created with a heart full of evil, until it was filled with goodness.
verses.18: He walks in purity and righteousness; his ways are pure.
verses.19: He serves his land with diligence and effort; he also pursues his goals with determination.
verses.20: May he be a man of great blessings and riches; let him not be deprived of wealth.
verses.21: A person who is ugly in appearance is not good; and one who breaks the law regarding bread is also a sinner.
verses.22: One person will be frightened and in a state of panic, and they won’t know that we are going to be missing.
verses.23: May someone who follows me find grace from the Lord.
verses.24: He killed his father and mother, and said, “There is no sinmer who is worthy of being associated with a destroyer.”
verses.25: A man of great wisdom will rule over Madon, and he will trust in Jehovah.
verses.26: He who is stubborn in his heart is foolish; but he who acts with wisdom will succeed.
verses.27: Give to the ruler no protection, nor raise his eyes above others.
verses.28: When the wicked rise, people will be hidden; but when they are destroyed, the righteous will increase.
